decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog title under Bug fixes [ev-86f6b7ab4312]. It says empty Lua scripts are no longer run for actions, but not what running them did before (an error, a no-op or a change to resources) or what an operator now sees. Without that, I can't tell whether the consequence is a real behavior-change or effectively none. To decide, we need the description of PR #22084 or #22161, or the related issue, showing the behavior before and after.
